deals.name: Smiling Buddha: Thai Yoga Massage
deals.price: $90 single · $150 for 2 sessions (a duo for two of us)
deals.note: Book via WhatsApp on their site. Studio payments are cash (or PayPal online). The 'by Dec 15' deadline from earlier research isn't shown on the official page now, so confirm when booking.

deals.name: Delfins Wellness Day Pass
deals.note: Beach + pools, a beach bed, towel (deposit), water and a 50-min Beach Spa massage. Reservation required.

deals.name: Carib Inn dive packages (our hotel)
deals.price: $125 6-day unlimited shore · $25/boat dive · $275 for 6 boat dives · $425 for 12
deals.note: Cheapest unlimited shore air we found, and it's on-site.

deals.name: Klein Bonaire water taxi (Epic)
deals.price: $25 round trip · snorkel gear $5 · chair $5 · lunch box + chairs +$17.50
deals.note: From Nautico Marina (30 min) or Buddy Dive (15 min). Free drift-snorkel drop-off on the 10:00/10:15 departures. Caribe Watersport also charges $25.

deals.name: Mangrove Center kayak + snorkel (2 h)
deals.note: 1-hour tour $40–45 and night kayak $75–80 (the official pages disagree). Bring your Nature Fee proof; a third-party listing says cash only.

spas.name: Massage Bonaire
spas.price: 60 min: $90 relaxation · $100 deep tissue/sports · $115 hot stone etc.

spas.name: Johana Massage on Bonaire
spas.note: Swedish, deep tissue, couples and mobile massage.

spas.name: Bamboo Day Spa (Bamboo Bonaire)
spas.price: 60 min $95 · 90 min $145 (Swedish, deep tissue, Lomi Lomi, hammam)

spas.name: Harbour Village spa
spas.note: Six treatment rooms incl. couples suites.

spas.name: Captain Don's Habitat spa (Graceful Touch)
spas.note: Couples massage, seaside cabana. (Rating shown is the resort's.)

spas.name: Plaza Resort: Senti Spa
spas.note: Opens during 2027 per the resort's own update, so not an option for this trip.

activities.note: Or drive yourselves (high-clearance truck). Nature Fee covers park entry. Closed Mondays; last entry 14:30.

activities.name: Flamingos
activities.note: Flamingos are commonly seen at the southern salt pans (Pekelmeer) and Gotomeer/Slagbaai; sightings vary.

save: Pay the Visitor Entry Tax and Nature Fee only on the official sites; reseller sites add fees
Carib Inn's $125 6-day shore package beats VIP ($205) and Dive Friends ($234), and it's on-site
Carib Inn guest truck $490/week vs. Budget Hilux ~$59–62/day and Bonaire Truck Rental from $53/day (with tank rack): compare once dates are set
Klein Bonaire by $25 water taxi + your own snorkel gear instead of a $60–90 snorkel tour
Cave + land-sail combo $110 vs. $120 booked separately
Delfins Wellness Pass ($120) bundles a full beach/pool day with a 50-min massage
Eat local (Maiky, Posada, Kos Bon So) for $8–16 plates; see the Food tab
Fill up at the government-set fuel price (gasoline $1.64/L from Aug 28, 2026)
